off to such a perfect
start, {01 00 00 05 00}{04 02 00}!
{07 0a 00}I just know the rest of my

messages.et:
Oh, tere, {01 00 00 05 00}{04 1f 00}.{01 00 00 0f 00}{07 00 00}
{07 14 00}On nii kena hommik,
kas pole?
Mulle meeldib, kui mu päev
algab nii täiuslikult,
{01 00 00 05 00}{04 02 00}!
{07 0a 00}Ma lihtsalt tean, et mu
ülejäänud päev tuleb

messages.en:
Oh, hi there, {01 00 00 05 00}{04 1f 00}!{01 00 00 0f 00}
It's awfully nice of you to
come say hi.
{07 14 00}You know, whenever you see

messages.et:
Oh, tere seal, {01 00 00 05 00}{04 1f 00}!{01 00 00 0f 00}
On väga kena, et sa tulid
tere ütlema.
{07 14 00}Tead, kui sa mind näed,
võid julgelt peatuda ja
vestelda!

messages.en:
{0b 03 00}{01 06 00}Oh, hi{01 07 00}!{01 00 00 05 00}
So, {04 1f 00},{01 00 00 05 00} how are
things going?
{07 14 00}What, me? Oh, {04 1f 00},
seeing you has made my
day, {01 00 00 05 00}{04 02 00}!
{07 0a 00}I couldn't be happier!
messages.et:
{0b 03 00}{01 06 00}Oh, tere{01 07 00}!{01 00 00 05 00}
Nii, {04 1f 00},{01 00 00 05 00} kuidas
asjad lähevad?
{07 14 00}Mis, mina? Oh, {04 1f 00},
sinu nägemine tegi mu
päeva, {01 00 00 05 00}{04 02 00}!
{07 0a 00}Ma ei võiks õnnelikum olla!

messages.en:
{0b 03 00}{01 06 00}Oh, hey there{01 07 00}!
{01 00 00 05 00}{0b 03 00}{04 02 00}!

{07 14 00}When my day gets off to a
good start,{01 00 00 05 00} I feel like
sharing it with everyone.{01 00 00 05 00}.{01 00 00 05 00}.{01 00 00 05 00}
I wish I could feel like this
all the time, {01 00 00 05 00}{04 02 00}!

messages.et:
{07 14 00}Terekest, {01 00 00 05 00}{04 1f 00}.{01 00 00 0f 00}
Sa näed täna hea
välja, {01 00 00 05 00}{04 02 00}!
{0b 03 00}{04 1f 00}, ma otsustasin
{04 22 00}, kuni
olen peatamatu!

messages.en:
{07 0e 00}Well, well, well. Is that
you, {04 1f 00}?

Listen, it's not that I'm
not happy to see you, but
{07 02 00}it's already {04 08 00}:{04 09 00}!
{07 06 00}And I had so much I wanted
to talk to you about today,
too, {01 00 00 05 00}{04 02 00}!
messages.et:
{07 0e 00}Noh, noh, noh. Kas see
oled sina, {04 1f 00}?

Kuule, pole nii, et ma
pole rõõmus sind näha, aga
{07 02 00}on juba {04 08 00}:{04 09 00}!
{07 06 00}Ja mul oli täna nii palju,
mida ma tahtsin sinuga
rääkida, {01 00 00 05 00}{04 02 00}!

messages.en:
{07 04 00}Oh, hi, {01 00 00 05 00}{04 1f 00}!{01 00 00 0f 00}
{07 00 00}Can you believe it's already
{04 08 00} o'clock, {01 00 00 05 00}{04 02 00}?
{07 0e 00}I wish you'd stopped by a
little earlier, so we'd have
more time to talk.
{07 00 00}.{01 00 00 05 00}.{01 00 00 05 00}.{01 00 00 05 00}I'm sure you had a lot
of things to do today.{01 00 00 0f 00} {07 14 00}I'm
sorry for being a crybaby.
messages.et:
{07 04 00}Oh, tere, {01 00 00 05 00}{04 1f 00}!{01 00 00 0f 00}
{07 00 00}Kas sa suudad uskuda, et on
juba {04 08 00}, {01 00 00 05 00}{04 02 00}?
{07 0e 00}Soovin, et oleksid natuke
varem läbi astunud, et meil

{07 00 00}.{01 00 00 05 00}.{01 00 00 05 00}.{01 00 00 05 00}Kindlasti oli sul täna

messages.en:
{07 04 00}Hey there, {01 00 00 05 00}{04 1f 00}.{01 00 00 0f 00}
Are you out for a quiet
{07 0b 00}evening stroll?
{07 14 00}Don't you know it's bad for
your health to stay up too
late, {01 00 00 05 00}{04 02 00}?
messages.et:
{07 04 00}Tere seal, {01 00 00 05 00}{04 1f 00}.{01 00 00 0f 00}
Kas sa oled vaiksel
{07 0b 00}õhtusel jalutuskäigul?
{07 14 00}Kas sa ei tea, et liiga
hilja üleval olla on su
tervisele halb, {01 00 00 05 00}{04 02 00}?

messages.en:
{07 06 00}I'd almost given up on
seeing you at all today.

{07 00 00}I totally understand that
you are a busy person.{01 00 00 05 00}.{01 00 00 05 00}.{01 00 00 05 00}

{07 14 00}But I hope that you
remember to stop by when
you get time, {01 00 00 05 00}{04 02 00}!
messages.et:
{07 06 00}Ma juba loobusin lootusest
sind täna näha.

{07 00 00}Ma mõistan täiesti, et
sa oled hõivatud inimene.{01 00 00 05 00}.{01 00 00 05 00}.{01 00 00 05 00}

{07 14 00}Aga ma loodan, et sa
